edges.reason: msg.sender is the caller address that flows into claim as the receiver and claimed-mapping key
claim performs an external ERC20 transfer to msg.sender based on caller-supplied data
claim reads and updates the claimed mapping for msg.sender
claim reads minAmountToClaim when validating the computed available amount
claim indirectly reads merkleRoots through verifyMerkleProofs
claim uses the token state variable for the reward transfer
setMinClaimAmount writes the minAmountToClaim state variable
setMerkleRoots deletes and rewrites the merkleRoots array
initialize assigns the token state variable
withdrawToken reads the token state variable to obtain the balance
withdrawToken performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer of the whole balance
claim calls verifyMerkleProofs and reverts if verification fails
verifyMerkleProofs reads the merkleRoots array at the given index
initialize parameter _token is assigned to the token state variable
setMinClaimAmount parameter _minAmount is written to minAmountToClaim
setMerkleRoots parameter _merkleRoots becomes the new merkleRoots array
withdrawToken parameter _recipient receives the transferred tokens
_recipient is the destination of the external token transfer
_merkleRootIndex selects the Merkle root used in claim
_amountAllowedToClaim drives the claim amount computation
_merkleProofs are forwarded to verifyMerkleProofs from claim
_account is hashed into the Merkle leaf inside verifyMerkleProofs
_merkleRootIndex indexes merkleRoots inside verifyMerkleProofs
_amountAllowedToClaim is hashed into the Merkle leaf inside verifyMerkleProofs
_merkleProofs are consumed by the MerkleProofUpgradeable verification
the enough modifier guards claim using _claimAmount
local availableAmount is computed in claim and used for the transfer amount
availableAmount determines the value of the external token transfer
local amount is read in withdrawToken and controls the transfer size
amount is the value transferred by the external safeTransfer
local node is the computed leaf compared against the stored root

normalization_plan.reason: _token parameter is only consumed by initialize when setting the token state variable
_minAmount parameter is only consumed by setMinClaimAmount when writing minAmountToClaim
_merkleRoots parameter is only consumed by setMerkleRoots when rewriting merkleRoots
_recipient parameter is only consumed by withdrawToken as the transfer destination
_merkleRootIndex parameter is only consumed by claim for Merkle root selection
_amountAllowedToClaim parameter is only consumed by claim for amount computation
_merkleProofs parameter is only consumed by claim before delegating to verifyMerkleProofs
_account parameter is only consumed by verifyMerkleProofs to build the leaf hash
_merkleRootIndex parameter is only consumed by verifyMerkleProofs for root lookup
_amountAllowedToClaim parameter is only consumed by verifyMerkleProofs to build the leaf hash
_merkleProofs parameter is only consumed by verifyMerkleProofs in the Merkle verification
_claimAmount parameter belongs to the enough modifier that guards claim
local availableAmount is created and used exclusively inside claim
local amount is created and used exclusively inside withdrawToken
local node is created and used exclusively inside verifyMerkleProofs
